name: unnecessary-export-external-test
description: A reference from an external test package, a test file whose package clause names its directory's package with the suffix _test, is a reference from outside the package, because that test builds as another package and needs the export. So an export such a test names is not reported as narrowable, one only such a test names is reported as test-only use, and one only its own package names is reported as narrowable.
